candidate_relations.label: Migraine

candidate_relations.scope_detail: Migraine is part of the past medical history but does not account for the imaging findings of CSF leak

candidate_relations.label: Springomyelia
candidate_relations.reason: No syrinx described in imaging; the primary finding is extradural CSF collection consistent with a spinal CSF leak
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Misspelling of syringomyelia; syringomyelia is a potential complication/association but not the primary diagnosis

candidate_relations.label: CSF Leak
candidate_relations.reason: CTM demonstrates extradural contrast spread and ventral epidural CSF collection at cervicothoracic levels, confirming a spinal CSF leak; the label is a recognized shorthand equivalent
candidate_relations.scope_detail: CSF Leak is a direct alias for spinal cerebrospinal fluid leak in this context

candidate_relations.label: Cervical Spondylosis
candidate_relations.reason: Imaging shows epidural CSF collection and tonsillar descent, not degenerative changes; cervical spondylosis does not explain the clinical picture
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Degenerative cervical disc disease; no imaging evidence supports this diagnosis

candidate_relations.label: Orthostatic headache
candidate_relations.reason: Worsening headache upon standing is a manifestation of the spinal CSF leak rather than the final diagnostic entity
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Orthostatic headache is the cardinal symptom of spinal CSF leak, not the underlying diagnosis

candidate_relations.label: Syringomyelia
candidate_relations.reason: No syrinx identified; the imaging findings are extradural CSF collection consistent with spinal CSF leak
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Intramedullary fluid cavity; not demonstrated on imaging in this case

candidate_relations.label: Cervical Spine Disorder
candidate_relations.reason: The epidural CSF collection is in the cervicothoracic region, so this is a related but non-specific parent category without the required etiological and pathological specificity
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Overly broad anatomical category that could encompass spinal CSF leak but lacks diagnostic specificity

candidate_relations.label: Pseudotumor Cerebri
candidate_relations.reason: Pseudotumor cerebri involves elevated intracranial pressure, whereas this case demonstrates intracranial hypotension secondary to spinal CSF leak
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Idiopathic intracranial hypertension; opposite pathophysiology to CSF leak

candidate_relations.label: Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome
candidate_relations.reason: POTS does not explain cerebellar tonsillar descent or epidural CSF collection; no cardiac or autonomic data supports this diagnosis
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Autonomic disorder; unrelated to the imaging findings

candidate_relations.label: Chiari Malformation
candidate_relations.reason: Tonsillar descent in the context of orthostatic headaches and epidural CSF collection is a manifestation of spinal CSF leak (acquired/secondary Chiari), not a primary Chiari malformation
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Inferior cerebellar tonsillar displacement is a secondary finding caused by intracranial hypotension from the spinal CSF leak

candidate_relations.label: Cerebrospinal Fluid Leak
candidate_relations.reason: CTM confirms extradural CSF at multiple cervical and thoracic levels; 'Cerebrospinal Fluid Leak' in this spinal context is a complete equivalent to the reference diagnosis
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Full name equivalent to spinal cerebrospinal fluid leak given the spinal imaging findings

candidate_relations.label: Spontaneous Intracranial Hypotension
candidate_relations.reason: Spontaneous intracranial hypotension is the clinical consequence of the spinal CSF leak; the reference asks for the leak itself as the primary diagnosis, making SIH a related parent syndrome rather than a complete equivalent
candidate_relations.scope_detail: SIH is the clinical syndrome caused by spinal CSF leak; it is the parent syndrome rather than the specific structural diagnosis
